name: proof-trust
title: Proof & Trust
description: Identify legitimate trust signals (licences, insurance, reviews, guarantees, certifications, response times) without fabricating anything.
when_to_use: Any client-facing site; especially local services.
instructions: List trust signals the client must supply and where they will appear; never invent testimonials, awards, ratings or statistics.
Use honest process-based trust (upfront pricing, what happens on a visit) when proof is not yet available.
